body:
[A10] Observed during manager cancellation of an obsolete source-validation run for #517. This is an existing gPTP plane verification-driver issue, outside that issue's ordinary milan_dp pooling change.

## Objective and evidence

A stopped full-sweep validation clone must not retain a deliberately broken tracked RTL file, and graceful cancellation must not launch later suites while shutdown is in progress.

At source `7ab1c8d0ad073fbc1977c455dea89b7b318d4e52`, stopping the manager-owned native unit left exactly the `age_never_expires` mutation from `tb/verilator/gptp_shadow/mutants.py` in `hdl/ieee8021as/gptp_plane/KL_gptp_txret.sv`: `age_hit_w` was prefixed with `1'b0 &&`. The subsequent preparation's dirty-tree guard correctly refused that clone. The source branch and user checkout were clean. The original native run remains partial, not PASS.

[Exact residue, original/pristine file hashes and bounded recovery](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/491c5992161cf3dbb5a52ad2d8f9862553b591d1/review-evidence/517-r1/stopped-native-residue). [Stopped sweep output](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/630e01f206e802dc5c4a6f58eb3a536e1684b05b/review-evidence/517-r1/first-source-incomplete).

The current mutation driver modifies the tracked source, waits for make, and restores only afterward, without a signal cleanup boundary or disposable source tree. The sweep loop records an interrupted child as FAIL and may continue the loop; establish the exact cancellation behavior with a controlled fixture before choosing the correction. The observation above proves residual mutation, not every proposed root cause or arbitrary-signal behavior.

## Authority and scope

CONTRIBUTING sections 2/3 and AGENTS sections 5/8; REQUIREMENTS REQ-VER-01/02/04; the mutation driver's own exact-restoration contract; `scripts/run_all_suites.sh:run_suites`; `tb/verilator/gptp_shadow/mutants.py:apply_control`, `run_suite`, `restore`, `main`.

The gPTP processor gitlink and PP (protocol processor) gitlink remain unchanged. This is parent verification tooling, not processor RTL or a product timing change. No mutation may be removed, marked passing on a build failure, or accepted merely because cancellation returned nonzero. No general sweep parallelization or weakened suite deadline is in scope.

## Acceptance and validation

1. Establish a deterministic interrupt fixture at a known mutation-applied boundary. It must fail on the current implementation by detecting changed tracked source after shutdown. Avoid a timing-only sleep oracle; use an observable handshake.
2. A settled cleanup/isolation design keeps all tracked source bytes/modes unchanged after normal completion, named mutant failure, build failure and handled INT/TERM. A hard kill cannot execute cleanup, so its containment requirement must be met by mutation isolation or explicitly settled before Ready; do not promise impossible finally behavior.
3. A graceful stop of the outer sweep starts no later suite, terminates/reaps owned descendants and leaves attributable partial logs with no completed-PASS claim. Verify a next-suite sentinel stays unexecuted, and use process identity to distinguish exited/reaped state.
4. The original complete gPTP plane/shadow controls still run and detect their named defects. Full required parent source/candidate validation, two independent reviews with all five lenses clean, hosted checks and post-merge containment remain mandatory.

## Readiness and dependencies

Backlog: settle mutation isolation and sweep cancellation scope publicly before implementation. Executor and independent reviewers are assigned at takeover. Coordinate with #517's ordinary-runner files without editing its active lane. No review finding or acceptance of #517 was waived by filing this issue; the preparation refusal was handled in the manager's disposable clone only.

Search of open and closed parent issues found no existing owner for this gPTP mutation residue. #334 concerns the separate trusted act runner; #438 concerns temporary-directory cleanup in containment tests. Neither owns this tracked-source mutation path.
title: [Verification] Interrupted gPTP mutation campaign leaves tracked RTL modified
